rental_asset_line_quantity: A unit line takes one unit.
rental_asset_not_bookable: This asset is not in the bookable register.
rental_availability_needs_target: Choose a unit or a model.
rental_block_over_booking: A booking already holds this asset for that time.
rental_block_window_order: The block ends before it starts.
rental_booking_conflict: This window is taken — the lines below say what is in the way.
rental_booking_needs_one_borrower: Name one borrower: a partner, a member, or a name outside the system.
rental_buffer_needs_model: Name a model for the buffer rule.
rental_buffer_needs_one_target: A buffer rule names a model or a category, not both.
rental_cancel_not_reserved: Only a reservation can be cancelled.
rental_extend_not_active: Only an active booking can be extended.
rental_extend_not_later: The new return must be later than the current one.
rental_extension_blocked: Another booking or block holds a unit in the extra time.
rental_kit_empty: A kit needs at least one member.
rental_kit_line_quantity: A kit line takes one kit.
rental_kit_member_names_one_kind: A kit member is a unit or a model, not both.
rental_kit_member_on_two_lines: One unit is on two lines of the kit.
rental_kit_name_taken: A kit with this name already exists.
rental_kit_not_in_booking: This kit is not part of the booking.
rental_line_names_one_kind: A line names one thing: a unit, a model, or a kit.
rental_model_line_needs_model: Choose a model for the line.
rental_model_not_in_fleet: No unit of this model is in the register.
rental_move_needs_same_model: A booking can only move to a unit of the same model.
rental_move_target_taken: That unit is already on the booking.
rental_pickup_asset_taken: Another booking or block holds this unit.
rental_pickup_duplicate_scan: The same unit was scanned twice.
rental_pickup_incomplete: Every line must be scanned or chosen before the hand-out.
rental_pickup_not_reserved: Only a reservation can be handed out.
rental_pickup_window_passed: The booking's window has passed; extend it before handing it out.
rental_return_not_picked_up: Only a handed-out booking can be returned.
rental_return_unknown_unit: Choose the units that are coming back.
rental_service_block_conflict: A later booking holds the unit this return sends to service.
rental_service_needs_reason_and_date: Needs service asks what happened and until when.
rental_service_until_in_past: The service must end in the future.
rental_unit_on_two_lines: One unit is on two lines; remove one of them.
rental_window_order: The return comes after the pickup.
